dossier.scp_unleashed.330.title: Take Two Please
dossier.scp_unleashed.330.caption: SCP-330 at intake on a cleared desk. The card was photographed where it stood, in front of the bowl.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-330 is kept on a table in a locked room watched by a single camera. Personnel may enter only with written approval, and only one at a time.
Anyone who takes a sweet from SCP-330 is to log it at once. %rThe log is checked before any later visit is approved.%r

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-330 is a plain brushed metal bowl about twenty centimetres across, with a rolled lip and a small foot, filled almost to the brim with wrapped sweets in six colours. A folded paper card stands in front of it. In careful lettering it reads: PLEASE TAKE TWO.

The bowl never empties. Sweets taken from it are ordinary in weight and wrapping, but every colour has had some effect on the person who ate it. Most of these effects were brief, and several were welcome.
Whatever wrote the card, staff are advised to take it at its word.

page.title: Addendum 330-1: Test Log
text: Test 330-02: D-5131 took two sweets and left the room. He reported a pleasant taste and nothing else.
Test 330-04: D-5140 took two sweets and ate both during a later test. He walked away from a fall that should have injured him.
Test 330-06: D-5148 was instructed to take a third sweet. %rThe remainder of this entry has been withdrawn.%r D-5148 did not complete the test.

page.title: Addendum 330-2: Note
page.text: Found taped under the bowl at intake, in the same careful lettering as the card: "Two is plenty. It remembers every face."

page.title: Addendum 330-3: Provenance
page.text: SCP-330 was brought to a reader of this file by the stooped old man in a knitted cardigan described in the file on SCP-224. He said the bowl had belonged to his late wife.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp330_bowl.1: SCP-330, Take Two Please, is a brushed metal bowl filled with wrapped sweets in six colours. A folded card in front of it reads PLEASE TAKE TWO.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp330_bowl.2: Use the bowl to take a sweet. It never runs out. The card is not a suggestion, and the bowl remembers every face.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp330_bowl.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-330 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal; a kindly old man will bring the bowl to the reader.
